The Company offers a diverse range of electrical products, including wires and cables, electric fans, water heaters, switches and switchgears, PVC insulated electrical tapes, PVC conduit pipes and accessories. drhp.expansion: A new manufacturing plant (Unit-III) was established and commenced business operations in Barotiwala, Himachal Pradesh, starting with the installation of new advanced machines in February 2025. This is in addition to the existing Baddi, Himachal Pradesh facility (Unit-II). The ramp-up of the Barotiwala facility strengthened production capabilities and is described as an important pillar of the Company's growth strategy, with the impact of this capacity expansion reflected in the year's financial performance.

moat.body:

- distribution: pan-India authorized dealer and distributor network — evidence: customers expanded to 32 states and union territories as of March 31, 2026

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Volatility in raw material prices, particularly copper and aluminium, can significantly impact production costs and margins.
- Shortages, transportation delays, and dependence on key suppliers may affect timely delivery and production schedules.
- The industry is exposed to intense competition and pricing pressure, which can limit margins, particularly in commoditized product segments.
- Increasingly important compliance requirements require continuous investment in testing, certification, safety and environmental standards.
- The shift toward renewable energy, smart grids, electric vehicles, and advanced cabling solutions requires the Company to continuously upgrade its product portfolio and manufacturing capabilities.
- Flagged as a concern affecting the Company's operations.
- Delays in government and private infrastructure projects can affect sales and capacity utilisation.
- Flagged as a concern that could affect operations.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Building Plaza Wires into a stronger, more diversified and trusted electrical solutions company by increasing utilisation of manufacturing infrastructure and the strength of the distribution platform.
- Continuing to focus on strengthening product portfolio, expanding market presence and enhancing operational capabilities to cater to growing demand for electrical and infrastructure-related products.
- Focussing on catering to international markets covering major countries in the upcoming financial years.
